name: Syntitan
description:
The Syntitan MCP server helps teams check whether enterprise data is ready for AI use. Connect a dataset from Claude to get a six-axis readiness score, review what blocks AI use in plain language, and refine what needs attention. Syntitan saves the refined data as a versioned release, so results can be compared, reproduced, and traced back to the exact data state used.

Key features:
• Score AI readiness - Check a dataset across six readiness dimensions and see what blocks AI use.

• Prepare data for AI execution - Refine missing, inconsistent, or hard-to-use data conditions before running AI workflows.

• Reproduce released data states - Save the prepared state as a release and return to it when results need to be checked.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Syntitan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Syntitan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.syntitan.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Syntitan MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Syntitan provides these MCP tools: estimate_dataset_run, get_ai_readiness_detail, get_ai_readiness_summary, get_column_profile, get_dataset_history, get_dataset_run_options, get_dataset_run_status, get_dataset_sample_rows, get_dataset_schema, get_diagnosis_guide, list_datasets, and start_dataset_run.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Syntitan?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Syntitan in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Syntitan requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Syntitan is developed by CUBIG. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
